## Pull request overview

This PR migrates fumadocs navigation from the deprecated `root: true` pattern to the new `---` separator pattern. The primary purpose is to update the documentation structure to comply with the latest fumadocs conventions.

**Changes:**
- Updated the references section metadata to use `title` instead of `label` + `root: true`
- Added `---` separator in main navigation to separate references from other sections
- Modified the doc generator script to emit the new format
- Added `package-lock.json` to `.gitignore` (project uses pnpm)

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| content/docs/meta.json | Added `---` separator before references section to create visual grouping |
| content/docs/references/meta.json | Replaced `label` and `root: true` with `title` following new fumadocs pattern |
| packages/spec/scripts/build-docs.ts | Updated doc generator to emit `title` instead of deprecated `label` + `root` |
| .gitignore | Added `package-lock.json` to prevent npm lock file commits (project uses pnpm) |

The PR description mentions migrating from `root: true` to the new fumadocs pattern, but several meta.json files in content/docs still use `root: true`:

- content/docs/introduction/meta.json (line 3)
- content/docs/objectql/meta.json (line 3)
- content/docs/objectui/meta.json (line 3)
- content/docs/objectos/meta.json (line 3)
- content/docs/developers/meta.json (line 3)

These files should also be updated to use `title` instead of the deprecated `label` and `root: true` pattern for consistency with the fumadocs migration.
